sites.name: Ballard Nature Center
sites.hours: Tue-Fri 8AM-4PM; Sat 12-4PM; Summer also Mon & Sun
sites.description: The center includes interpretive exhibits and collections of Native American artifacts from the Wabash River region alongside natural history displays.

sites.name: Teutopolis Monastery Museum
sites.description: Museum exhibits in the Franciscan monastery include regional Native American artifacts together with materials on early Catholic settlement in the area.

sites.name: Hutsonville Memorial Village Museum
sites.description: Open-air village museum preserving historic structures with displays that include locally recovered Native American artifacts from the Wabash Valley.

sites.name: Newton Public Library District
sites.description: Public library facility with a small display of Native American artifacts representing local archaeological finds.
sites.notes: Library hours vary; not archaeology-focused facility

sites.name: Crawford County Historical Museum
sites.description: County museum featuring collections from the Wabash River valley, including prehistoric Native American artifacts and materials from early settlement.

sites.name: Fife Opera House
sites.description: Historic opera house building used for events, with limited displays of local artifacts reflecting regional history.

sites.name: Olney Carnegie Building Museum
sites.description: Museum housed in a historic Carnegie building with exhibits that include Native American artifacts from the Olney area.

sites.name: White County Historical Society Museum
sites.description: Local history museum preserving artifacts from White County, including Native American materials from sites in the surrounding region.
